| Surfaces | Host + Web client (Settings budget tab); `/budget` command |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"`dsh-budget` turns the session event stream into a four-in-one cost governance loop:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **Aggregated metering** — tokens (uncached input / output / cache read / cache write), estimated U"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"SD cost, and carbon footprint per model, session, and day, priced through a built-in USD-per-1M tabl"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"e merged with your `config.prices`.
- **Budget governance** — session/daily/monthly caps; a warn-rat"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"io threshold alert (webhook POST + desktop-notification flag) and three over-limit policies: `alert`"},{"id":"p31s5","text":" (notify only), `block` (short-circuit new model requests until the user lifts the block), `degrade`"},{"id":"p31s6","text":" (block with corrective guidance naming the cheaper model from your `degradation` map).
- **Carbon &"},{"id":"p31s7","text":" latency** — token→carbon bridge (tokens × kWh/token × PUE × regional grid intensity, ported from AI"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"-Carbon-Footprint-Calculator) and per-model latency percentiles.
- **Surfaces** — the Settings budge"},{"id":"p31s9","text":"t tab (usage bars, per-day usage curve, model breakdown, alerts, cap editors, unblock buttons) and t"},{"id":"p31s10","text":"he `/budget` command (`/budget`, `/budget models`, `/budget unblock <scope>`)."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Security boundaries"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- **No fabrication**: a budget block yields a corrective error finish on the `llm/stream` waterfall "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"— the plugin never invents model output.
- **No request rewriting**: loop-built requests are frozen;"},{"id":"p33s3","text":" `degrade` therefore names the target model in the corrective message instead of swapping the reques"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"t.
- **Fail loud**: invalid prices, URLs, ratios, regions, and bounds fail the mount.
- **Honest sco"},{"id":"p33s5","text":"pe**: runtime edits from the panel are session-scoped; a reload restores the cordis.yml values."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- Aggregation is process-local: usage resets when the harness restarts (per-day/per-month buckets re"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"build from the current session log view).
- `block`/`degrade` rely on the `llm/stream` waterfall; ha"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"rness builds without that seam cannot block requests (alerts still work).
- Built-in prices drift; o"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"verride entries via `config.prices`."}],"truncated":true}
